title: Standings computed from matches but cross-source dedup/normalization is incomplete, so totals double-count
evidence: query.go:465-533 computes standings from match results (3/1/0, not hardcoded) over query.go:819-860 analyticsMatches, which dedups via analyticsKey (query.go:839) on exact Competition|Season|Date[:10]|HomeKey|AwayKey|HomeGoals|AwayGoals. The exact-date+score key does NOT collapse the same fixture recorded on a +/-1-day local-vs-UTC date across Brasileirao_Matches.csv, BR-Football-Dataset.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv, nor rows whose team spelling normalize.go:24 teamAliases misses. _factual.json confirms: 2019 Serie A Flamengo played=50/points=121 (expected 38/90 ~= double), and 5 Atletico/Athletico rows vs expected 2. Server banner loaded 23954 rows = the un-reconciled sum of the overlapping files.
suggestion: Dedup on (normalized home, normalized away) allowing a +/-1-day date tolerance and tolerating score disagreement/NULLs; extend teamAliases (normalize.go:24) to cover the remaining source spellings so Atletico-MG / Athletico-PR collapse to two rows.

title: Latency test skips when repository data is absent
evidence: server_test.go:332 t.Skip("repository data is unavailable") — guarded by os.Stat on data/kaggle/Brasileirao_Matches.csv. Data IS present in this run (data/kaggle/), so the test executes here; the skip is a graceful guard, not an active skip.
suggestion: Acceptable as a portability guard; no action needed while data ships with the run.
